newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Retail buying continues to feed Bel-20 index.
newsitem.headline: Retail buying continues to feed Bel-20 index.

text.p: A steady flow of buying by retail investors continued to underpin the Bel-20 index of leading shares on Friday although dealers adviced some caution ahead a long holiday weekend followed by the FOMC meeting.
"I don't see us go down, there is still quite some buying activity by private clients," said Patricia Decolvenaer at De Maertelaere.
"Dealers are looking forward to the long weekend although at the same time it is making people cautious," she said.
At 0845 GMT, the Bel-20 index was up 0.28 percent, or 6.38 points, at 2,257.68
Utility Electrabel, the market leader in value terms, was unchanged at 8,250 francs.
Chemicals firm Tessenderlo, which announced a surprise 30 percent rise in first-quarter pre-tax profits on Thursday, was up 1.3 percent at a new high of 16,925 francs.
Chemicals and drugs firm UCB was up 0.4 percent at 96,200 after announcing on Thursday it opened a factory in Malaysia, representing a potential turnover of about 1.5 billion francs.
